review_notes: I read the whole target file. I grepped Mathlib for other local-closure constructions and found a second `sourceLocalClosure` in Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/LocalClosure.lean, which I read in part. I also read the LocalIso.lean uses of it. I found no relevant duplicate in Batteries or Lean core. I did not check whether the two versions are provably equal, or in what generality. The generic lemma `sourceLocalClosure_iff_of_respectsLeft` suggests they agree only under extra hypotheses (RespectsIso, RespectsLeft, a K with isos, base change and composition), so the AG version may be a deliberately more concrete, existential representation. I therefore report a single, moderately confident finding. Mathlib has no other duplicate of this concept inside the file itself.

findings.problem: Mathlib now has two independent definitions of the source local closure of a morphism property along a precoverage. This file defines the generic inductive `CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.sourceLocalClosure K P`. `AlgebraicGeometry.sourceLocalClosure W P` is defined separately for schemes, as `∃ 𝒰 : Scheme.Cover (Scheme.precoverage W) X, ∀ i, P (𝒰.f i ≫ f)`. This is the same concept: a property holding after precomposing with a K-cover of the source. The specialisation is `K = Scheme.precoverage W`. The two share a name and have parallel API. `le` and `ContainsIdentities` are proved in both files, and `IsStableUnderBaseChange` is proved in both. Both files carry the same docstring theme, and both open `CategoryTheory MorphismProperty`. The AG file does not import or use the generic one. The generic file already proves the bridge `sourceLocalClosure_iff_of_respectsLeft`, which is never applied to schemes. Downstream, `IsLocalIso` is tied only to the AG version through `eq_sourceLocalClosure_isOpenImmersion`. Results about the generic closure, such as `IsLocalAtSource` and `le_of_isLocalAtSource`, therefore do not apply to it.
findings.proposed_change: Integrate the two. For example, redefine or replace `AlgebraicGeometry.sourceLocalClosure W P` by the generic `sourceLocalClosure (Scheme.precoverage W) P`, or keep it as an abbreviation for that. Keep the existential characterisation as a lemma derived from `sourceLocalClosure_iff_of_respectsLeft`, or as a separate lemma with a hypothesis such as `P.RespectsIso` where needed. Then derive the AG stability instances (ContainsIdentities, IsStableUnderBaseChange) from the generic ones. If the existential form is kept for convenience, document in both files why two versions exist, and rename one to avoid the clash.
findings.benefit: There would be one `sourceLocalClosure` with one universal property, `le_of_isLocalAtSource`. The duplicated proofs of identities and base-change stability would be maintained once. The name would no longer be ambiguous when both namespaces are open. `IsLocalIso` would also get the generic API, including the `IsLocalAtSource` instance.
